description: DRAFT. Capability descriptors: typed functions a device offers to its peers. The namespace org.ligatureprotocol is a placeholder; the domain is not yet registered.

descriptor.description: One capability offered by one device. Embedded in org.ligatureprotocol.device and announced over the transport.

type.description: NSID of the capability type, for example org.ligatureprotocol.capability.clipboard.

version.description: Version of the capability type's operation set this device implements.

label.description: Optional human-readable label, for example the name of a display.

params.description: Type-specific parameters. The schema is defined by the capability type's own Lexicon.

family.description: Initial capability families. Each will receive its own Lexicon.
